scenes.title: One world. Every vehicle.
scenes.text: This is our vehicle tuning playground: a selectable world for the Safari, original buggy, and Baja four twenty-seven.

scenes.title: Let the wheels work
scenes.text: Cross-axle ruts and repeated bumps reveal wheel travel, grip, and body movement. The wheels, suspension, and chassis now react together.

scenes.title: Find the limits
scenes.text: Steep grades still expose traction limits. The ridge and side slope test balance and braking, helping us find what to tune next.

scenes.title: Three vehicles. One jump line.
scenes.text: Two Excitebike-inspired jumps reveal takeoff attitude, suspension droop, and landing compression. All three vehicles clear the jumps using the same coupled physics.

scenes.title: Put the air to work
scenes.text: Steady crosswinds and repeatable gusts change forces and tire loads. The gantry supports aerodynamic tuning, using estimated coefficients rather than measured airflow.

scenes.title: A proving ground for what's next
scenes.text: Future games can include this same testing world. Seventy-nine physics checks and six regression tests pass. The next step is your hands-on feedback.
